name: Microlink
tagline: Unified API for URL metadata, screenshots, PDFs, and content extraction.
description: Microlink turns any URL into structured metadata, screenshots, PDFs, and extracted content via a single REST endpoint. Developers pass a target URL plus optional flags (meta, screenshot, pdf, data extraction) and receive JSON with title, description, images, and generated assets. Useful for link previews, open-graph enrichment, and automated visual capture.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header or apiKey query parameter; free tier works without a key with lower limits. Self-serve signup at microlink.io.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 50 requests/day free (unauthenticated); Pro plans for higher volume
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and custom plans available; see microlink.io/pricing

rate_limits: Free: ~50 req/day; authenticated Pro plans have higher daily/monthly quotas (see pricing)
use_cases: fetch Open Graph and meta tags for a URL
generate a screenshot of a web page
create a PDF from a URL
extract structured content from an article
build rich link previews in an app
